title: Jonah Lomu Rugby
overview:
It's the official Jonah Lomu Rugby game: play hard and fast with the world's most powerful winger in the video game that he helped design!

- 32 Rugby Union teams.
- Friendly, Tournament, World Cup, Territories Cup or Classic Matches.
- Individual player attributes.
- Variable weather conditions.
- 1-4 player action with co-operative and challenge modes.
